'''Kraay''' was a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro the Hutt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He sent an Imperial spacer to rescue [[Zeven]] who was enslaved by [[Voontara Fa'athra|Fa'athra's]] men.
